description: This PHP source file defines the SuiteTCPDF class which extends the TCPDF class to customize PDF header and footer rendering for the SuiteCRM project. The class manages HTML content for headers and footers, allowing dynamic variable replacement such as page numbers and dates.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\PDF\TCPDF\SuiteTCPDF
classes.description: A subclass of TCPDF that allows setting customized HTML headers and footers with dynamic content replacement.

methods.name: getHtmlHeader
methods.description: Returns the stored HTML content used in the header.

methods.name: setHtmlHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the header.

methods.name: getHtmlFooter
methods.description: Returns the stored HTML content used in the footer.

methods.name: setHtmlFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the footer, replacing placeholders for page number and date.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to output the header HTML content.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to output the footer HTML content.
